high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing area. The individual is standing against a plain white wall with a door partially visible on the right side of the frame. The floor is tiled with light-colored tiles. The person is wearing a dark denim shirt with a subtle pattern, rolled-up sleeves, and dark jeans. They have their left hand in their pocket and are holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The phone has a dual-camera setup on the back. The person is also wearing white sneakers with black accents.
